# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

ZeroLabz treats the integrity of the UniGas ecosystem—specifically the gasless transaction relayer, paymaster logic, and account abstraction infrastructure—with the highest priority.

If you identify a vulnerability—especially concerning relayer exploits, gas griefing, unauthorized payload execution, or paymaster depletion—please do not disclose it publicly.

1. Email vulnerability details to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
2. Include reproduction steps, affected chains (e.g., Pi Network, Arbitrum, Story Protocol), and potential attack vectors.
3. You will receive an initial response within 48 hours acknowledging receipt and next steps.
